actions.description: The FDD's design is traceable to its source BRD/ADR, honestly distinguishes real code-shaped deliverables from documentation-only items, and does not invent implementation detail beyond what is grounded in real code -- approve it
The FDD has a fundamental, unfixed flaw in its own design or traceability -- reject it outright
The FDD's own design or scope needs a real change before it can be judged -- distinct from a named, deliberately out-of-scope follow-on item the FDD itself already scoped correctly

metadata.decision_context: Approve, reject, or request revision of a Functional Design Document

complexity_profile.rationale: Reused directly from sidpa-template's own shared-complexity-profile.json, which itself was corrected from a real ADPA mistake (approve-adr was first built with requires_human_approval: false, and the resolver's own execute_without_confirmation logic would have bypassed a real governance rule as a result). Correct this down per-policy only with real evidence the specific decision doesn't need a human sign-off -- never flip it the other direction speculatively.
